scenario: [LGRA.2.9.6.10] — how a numeric or string spec renders, one log line per rule of the clause, pinned as text. The specs compile to ValuePrim primitives (RLOW.6.4) and the runtime renders them itself: libds's `render_value` on this lane, and Mercury's renderer through the conformance gate's runtime differential. Lines: (1) no type — each kind's canonical text; (2-6) one per type, with `f` on an Int rendering the Float of the same value and six places by default; (7) `+` on a non-negative and a negative number; (8) zero padding between the sign and the digits, Int and Float; (9) both alignments, on a number and on a String; (10) the default alignment — a number right, a String and a Bool left; (11) a negative `x` / `X` / `b` is `-` and the magnitude, no prefix; (12) a String precision cuts by code points, `é` being one, and the width counts code points; (13) text longer than its width is written whole; (14) a null renders empty, with no padding, whatever the spec.
rules_ds:
schema V scope logical:
    id: Int key
    i: Int mutable
    n: Int mutable
    f: Float mutable
    s: String mutable
    bl: Bool mutable
    u: String? mutable

rule show:
    V v
->
    log critical "none i={v.i} f={v.f} s={v.s} b={v.bl}"
    log critical "d=[{v.i:d}]"
    log critical "x=[{v.i:x}] X=[{v.i:X}]"
    log critical "b=[{v.i:b}]"
    log critical "f=[{v.f:f}] int_f=[{v.i:f}]"
    log critical "s=[{v.s:s}]"
    log critical "plus=[{v.i:+d}] [{v.n:+d}] [{v.f:+.2f}]"
    log critical "zero=[{v.i:06d}] [{v.n:07d}] [{v.i:+06d}] [{v.f:08.3f}]"
    log critical "align=[{v.i:<6d}] [{v.i:>6d}] [{v.s:>8}] [{v.s:<8}]"
    log critical "default=[{v.i:6}] [{v.f:9}] [{v.s:8}] [{v.bl:6}]"
    log critical "neg=[{v.n:x}] [{v.n:X}] [{v.n:b}]"
    log critical "prec=[{v.s:.2s}] [{v.s:>4.2s}]"
    log critical "wide=[{v.s:3}] [{v.i:1d}]"
    log critical "null=[{v.u}] [{v.u:>6}] [{v.u:<6s}]"
